title: Feature: Dark mode + theme toggle for React primary adapter
resolution_note: Audit on 2026-04-15: tailwind.config.js had `darkMode:['class']` already, useTheme hook + theme-toggle button shipped via earlier ADR-014 work, and 49 dark: variants are in active use. The remaining gap was components written before tokenization that still used bare stone-* classes. This session migrated the two flagged files (ProviderSidebar, MigrationGuide) to semantic shadcn tokens (border-border, bg-secondary, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, bg-card, etc.) plus added dark variants to the colored severity palette (red/amber/green for breaking/deprecated/non-breaking badges). Eight other files still have bare stone-* references — captured in wp-ux-dark-mode-residual-tokenization for a focused follow-up.

done: src/pages/DiffViewer.jsx — uses stone/amber palette with hardcoded bg-stone-50 / text-stone-800 classes
src/components/diff/*.jsx — shares palette via utility classes (no theme tokens)
tailwind.config — default (class-based darkMode not yet enabled)

steps.description: Enable Tailwind class-based dark mode. Set darkMode: 'class' in tailwind.config so consumers can apply <html class="dark"> to flip the palette without system-pref coupling.

Add useTheme hook in src/hooks/use-theme.js that reads localStorage('apidiff:theme') with system-pref fallback (prefers-color-scheme), exposes { theme, setTheme, toggle }, and writes the 'dark' class to documentElement on change. Persists choice across sessions.
steps.done_condition: hook toggles html.dark class and persists to localStorage; initial render respects system pref when no stored value

steps.description: Add dark: variant classes to DiffViewer.jsx and all src/components/diff/*.jsx. Map stone-50 -> stone-900, stone-800 -> stone-100, white -> stone-800, border-stone-200 -> stone-700, red-50 -> red-900/40, blue-50 -> blue-900/40. Keep amber-600 accent for both themes. Do not introduce new palette colors.
steps.done_condition: every diff component renders legibly in both themes; no stone-50/white backgrounds remain without a dark: counterpart

steps.description: Add theme toggle button to DiffViewer.jsx header next to scroll-lock button. Sun icon for light mode, Moon icon for dark mode, aria-label='Toggle theme'. Uses useTheme hook. Matches existing icon-button styling (h-8, rounded-md, stone-400 hover).
steps.done_condition: toggle visible in header; clicking flips theme; state persists on reload

steps.description: Visual regression check: load sample fixture pairs in both themes and verify diff badges (added/removed/renamed/moved/type-change) remain distinguishable. Contrast ratio >=4.5:1 for body text in dark mode.
steps.done_condition: manual screenshot comparison attached to PR; no badge color collides with dark background
